Fresh whole ear corn, packed at Theo's Farm and shipped direct to your wildlife feeder. Choose a 20 lb or 40 lb bag of cleaned cob corn, packed to order at the farm.

Order at https://theosfarm.com

Good wildlife corn starts with good ears. Theo's Farm removes husks and foreign material, then takes out small or partially filled ears before each order is packaged.

See our whole ear corn at https://theosfarm.com

Theo's Farm is part of a sixth-generation family farm dating back to 1894, with 40 years of experience growing and packaging ear corn for wildlife food.

Learn more and shop at https://theosfarm.com

Stocking a backyard feeder or a larger wildlife feeding area? Theo's Farm offers 20 lb and 40 lb bags of whole ear corn so you can choose the amount that fits your setup.

Compare both sizes at https://theosfarm.com

Every Theo's Farm bag is packaged to order. That means we do not ship old bagged inventory - your whole ear corn is prepared when your order is ready to go.

Order direct at https://theosfarm.com

Whole ear corn needs solid shipping protection. Each Theo's Farm order is packed in a durable woven bag, wrapped with a paper overlay, and boxed for the trip from our farm to your feeder.

See how we ship at https://theosfarm.com

Keep your wildlife feeder ready for the week ahead with whole ear corn from Theo's Farm. Our 20 lb and 40 lb bags ship direct from the farm for deer, squirrels, and backyard wildlife.

Shop at https://theosfarm.com
